findings.description: From 0:00-0:04 the chrome bullet-shaped hood ornament sits well forward on the hood near its front edge. At 0:06 an identical bullet ornament suddenly appears mounted at the base of the windshield (cowl area), where no ornament existed in earlier frames, and the original front-hood position no longer shows it — the object effectively teleports/duplicates as the camera moves in.

The plate reads approximately 'STE197', but the numeric characters are unevenly spaced and partially merged/smudged, inconsistent with real stamped plate lettering — a typical artifact of generated text.
